content:
Here are some simple, professional ways to acknowledge an email, depending on the situation. You can adjust formality as needed.

---

### 1. Basic acknowledgement (neutral, professional)

**Subject:** Re: [Original Subject]

Hi [Name],

Thank you for your email. I’ve received it and will review the details.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]

---

### 2. Acknowledging with a promise to respond later

Hi [Name],

Thanks for your message. I’ve received it and will get back to you with a detailed response by [day or time].

Best,  
[Your Name]

---

### 3. Very brief acknowledgement (informal or internal)

Hi [Name],

Got it, thanks.

[Your Name]

---

### 4. When you need to confirm receipt of documents

Hi [Name],

Thank you for sending [the documents/the report/the files]. I confirm that I’ve received them and will review them by [timeframe].

Kind regards,  
[Your Name]

---

### 5. When you agree and no further detail is needed

Hi [Name],

Thanks for the update. That works for me.

Best,  
[Your Name]

---

If you paste the email you’re replying to (without sensitive details), I can write a tailored acknowledgment you can send.
